secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing key for session cookies, CSRF/challenge tokens and encrypted LinkedIn tokens. Without it the API boots with an ephemeral key, so sign-ins and human checks break on every restart.

secrets.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Optional. LinkedIn OAuth client id from the LinkedIn developer portal. Until it is set, LinkedIn sign-in and milestone publishing stay disabled.

secrets.name: LINKEDIN_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. LinkedIn OAuth client secret from the LinkedIn developer portal. Required together with LINKEDIN_CLIENT_ID to enable LinkedIn.
